tool.name: Deacon
tool.description: Data manager to download or build a Deacon database
tool.command: echo "Running in test mode: $test" && mkdir -p '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #if str($test) != "true" #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" #if $download == "human" zenodo_get 17288185 -m -g "*.idx" -o '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #elif $download == "mouse" zenodo_get 17699167 -m -g "*.idx" -o '$out_file.extra_files_path' && #else echo "Invalid prebuilt index selection" 1>&2 && exit 1 && #end if #else deacon index build '$input.from_dm.fields.path' -o '$out_file.extra_files_path/${input.from_dm.fields.value}.idx' && #end if #else #set prebuilt_index_shortname = "testrun-1" touch '$out_file.extra_files_path'/test.idx && #end if cat '$dmjson' && cp '$dmjson' '$out_file'

configfiles.configfile: #from datetime import datetime #set time=datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") { "data_tables":{ "deacon":[ { #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" #if $download == "human" "path":"panhuman-1.k31w15.idx", #else "path":"panmouse-1.k31w15.idx", #end if, #else "path":"${input.from_dm.fields.value}.idx", #end if "dbkey":"", #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" #if $download == "human" #set prebuilt_index_shortname = "panhuman-17288185" "name":"panhuman-1 (k=31, w=15)", #elif $download == "mouse" #set prebuilt_index_shortname = "panmouse-17699167" "name":"panmouse-1 (k=31, w=15)", #end if #else "name":"${input.from_dm.fields.value} (k=31, w=15)", #end if #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" "version":"@TOOL_VERSION@", #else "version":"@TOOL_VERSION@", #end if #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" "value":"${prebuilt_index_shortname}", #else "value":"custom-${time}", #end if "format_version":"3", #if $input.is_select == "prebuilt" "note":"Prebuilt index files from the developers of deacon" #else "note":"Build from FASTA file ${input.from_dm.fields.value}" #end if } ] } }

param.name: is_select
param.label: Choose how to add data to the DM
param.option: Build index file from FASTA files available in Galaxy all_fasta table

param.name: download
param.label: Select which prebuilt should be downloaded
param.help: See help section for more information

validator.message: No genomes are available to build an index from

tool.help: Download prebuilt index files for deacon or build an index from FASTA files available on the Galaxy server in the all_fasta data table.
